name: Why Would I Deceive You?
format: Deadpan “Why would I deceive you?” audio over on-screen text about something that is definitely about to let you down.
structure: 1.5s audio hook, one line of on-screen text, then a held visual punchline. Loops in 6–10s with no face.
whyItFits: The whole mechanic is a phone caption plus one object. A 7-second bathroom-counter shot can state the smoky amber + fig claim as the “letdown” text and leave the black glass bottle as the punchline, which reads as UGC rather than a polished ad.
brandFitReason: Deadpan letdown text already fits a 7-second phone caption, and the black bottle can be the only thing in frame that refuses to disappoint.
